result:
task: Fix the one red from the lead's verification. W2-61's visible-half test could not find the line `    fused = rrf(routes)` in `src/gov/retrieval/retrieve.py`. The fix changes form only, not behaviour.
status: DONE. The failing W2-61 test passes now, and the done-when command gives 118 passed, 1 skipped, 0 failed.
work_completed: At `060e03ef57ea` the line was `fused = order.fused(rrf(routes), chunks)`. I split it into two lines. The first is `fused = rrf(routes)`, which is exactly the line q11.yaml names. The second is `fused = order.fused(fused, chunks)`, with the W2-87 comment kept. The calls and their order are the same, so `gov retrieve` returns the same bundle.
files_changed: src/gov/retrieval/retrieve.py
evidence: Commit `cffef92c8534`, with trailers Task: DAEO-s9qc / Implements: DEC-952 / Role: engineer / Co-Authored-By: Claude Opus 5.5 <noreply@anthropic.com>. The diff is 2 insertions and 1 deletion, around line 141 of `src/gov/retrieval/retrieve.py`.
tests: `PYTHONPATH=/home/usain/gov-os-worktrees/W2-87/src python3 -m pytest tests/acceptance/W2-61/test_w2_61_visible_half.py tests/acceptance/W2-87 tests/unit/retrieval -q -p no:cacheprovider`. Before the commit it gave 1 failed, 117 passed, 1 skipped. After the commit it gave 118 passed, 1 skipped.
discoveries: The W2-61 test checks each source against the committed file at HEAD, not the working tree (`_at_head`). The fix only shows up once it is committed, which is why the first run, before the commit, still failed. Also, `git status` shows untracked dotfiles in the worktree root (`.bashrc`, `.gitconfig`, `.mcp.json`, `.idea`, `.vscode` and others). The status at session start was clean and I did not create them, so they are probably sandbox mount placeholders. I left them alone.
risks: none. Same calls in the same order, so behaviour does not change.
lessons: The evaluation set's headings are tied to exact source lines in `retrieve.py`. Folding or rewording one of those lines breaks W2-61 even when behaviour stays the same. Check `fixtures/evaluation/` headings before changing lines in retrieval code.
proposed_decisions: none
unresolved: none
